status: DISCOVERY_ONLY — schema/row-count observations, NOT bound selectors

access_method.parquet_files: main checkout Data/work/loop/*.parquet read directly (no DB connection held)
access_method.loop_db: one short read-only loop_connection() session, opened and closed in the same script (seconds); schema + row counts only
access_method.worktree_data_dir: ASADO-exp-Nonlinear/Data/ contains ONLY git-tracked files (xlsx, dislocations, runs) — no duckdb, no Data/loop, no Data/work. loopdb.BASE_DIR resolves per-worktree, so worktree-local pipeline code cannot reach the live DBs; all data access is via absolute main-tree paths or snapshots.

t2_factors_daily.db: main warehouse, attached read-only as schema 'asado'
t2_factors_daily.role: PRICE/RETURN SOURCE OF TRUTH. Provides USD TRI levels (entry/exit marks) and backward-labeled trading-day returns via loopdb.daily_country_returns(). T2 '1DRet' is a FORWARD calendar-grid label — never consumed directly; the backward-shifted helper is the audited path. 20DRet/60DRet/120DRet are forward labels — hard-blacklisted as predictors AND not usable as labels (label must be constructed independently from TRI levels per PRD).

daily_calendar.db: asado.daily_calendar (exists; column detail deferred to P01)
daily_calendar.role: trading-day calendar reference; the study still builds INDEPENDENT per-market session calendars from TRI marks per P02 — this table is a cross-check, not the calendar of record
